metadata.question: Does forest cover in the Madre de Dios region of Peru decrease in 2018 compared to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: Madre de Dios region, Peru (approx. -12.5°, -70.5°) - Collections: Use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (annual forest cover) or Landsat-derived forest cover - Dates: Compare 2013 vs. 2018 - The Hansen dataset provides annual forest cover loss and tree cover percentage, ideal for this comparison 2. **Masking Strategy**: - No cloud masking needed; Hansen data is already processed and represents forest cover probability - We'll extract tree cover percentages for both years from the same dataset 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid answers (A/B): Forest cover % is a valid number in range [0-100] - If we cannot retrieve data for either year → C1 (Empty Collection) - If pixel count is 0 after processing → C2 (No Valid Pixels) - If result is None/NaN or out of valid range → C3 (Calculation Failure) - If forest cover 2018 < 2013 → A (Yes, decrease) - If forest cover 2018 >= 2013 → B (No, did not decrease) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Madre de Dios region, Peru const madreDeDios = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-73.2, -13.0, -68.0, -11.5]); // Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_10'); // Extract tree cover for 2013 and 2018 const treeCover2013 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); // Baseline year 2000 const lossYear = hansen.select('loss_year'); // Year of loss (1-23 = 2001-2023) // For 2013: pixels with no loss by 2013 have treecover2000, others reduced by annual loss // For 2018: pixels with loss_year <= 18 (by 2018) have lost trees // Create masks: 1 if forest exists, 0 if lost const forestMask2013 = treeCover2013.gt(10).and( lossYear.eq(0).or(lossYear.gt(13)) // No loss OR loss after 2013 ); const forestMask2018 = treeCover2013.gt(10).and( lossYear.eq(0).or(lossYear.gt(18)) // No loss OR loss after 2018 ); // Calculate mean tree cover for each year in the region const cover2013 = treeCover2013.updateMask(treeCover2013.gt(10)) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: madreDeDios, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000'); const cover2013Info = await ee.data.computeValue(cover2013); // Count valid forest pixels for 2013 const pixelCount2013 = treeCover2013.updateMask(treeCover2013.gt(10)) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: madreDeDios, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000'); const pixelCount2013Info = await ee.data.computeValue(pixelCount2013); // Calculate forest cover loss 2013-2018 const lossArea = hansen.select('loss').updateMask( lossYear.gte(14).and(lossYear.lte(18)) ); const lossPixels = lossArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: madreDeDios, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('loss'); const lossPixelsInfo = await ee.data.computeValue(lossPixels); // Get total forest pixels in 2013 with valid coverage const totalForestPixels2013 = await ee.data.computeValue(pixelCount2013Info); const avgCover2013 = await ee.data.computeValue(cover2013Info); print(`2013 Forest: Avg Cover=${avgCover2013?.toFixed(1) || 'N/A'}%, Valid Pixels=${totalForestPixels2013 || 0}`); print(`2013-2018 Loss: ${lossPixelsInfo || 0} pixels lost`); // Validation checks if (totalForestPixels2013 === null || totalForestPixels2013 === 0) { print("No valid forest pixels in 2013."); print("C2"); return; } if (avgCover2013 === null || isNaN(avgCover2013) || avgCover2013 < 0 || avgCover2013 > 100) { print("Invalid tree cover value."); print("C3"); return; } if (lossPixelsInfo === null || lossPixelsInfo === 0) { print("No forest loss detected 2013-2018."); print("B"); return; } // Forest loss occurred = decrease in forest cover print(`Forest loss occurred: ${lossPixelsInfo} pixels (${((lossPixelsInfo/totalForestPixels2013)*100).toFixed(2)}% of 2013 forest)`); print("A"); } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
